text_block_list.name: Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Kei-chan! Did you come to play the 
piano again!?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, yeah. I promised the others, so I'm 
going to borrow the one from the playroom.

text_block_list.name: Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Hm? ............Hey, Kei-chan. Forget 
about the piano and take a rest here. I'll 
go check for an open hospital room right 
now.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Why? I'm totally fine, you know?

text_block_list.name: Nurse
text_block_list.text:
No, your fatigue is showing on your face. 
Haven't you been getting enough rest 
lately? Just because you've been 
discharged from the hospital doesn't mean 
you can overdo it, okay?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...Do I look tired? My body definitely 
feels heavier than usual, but..."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
......Phew. I need to make sure I don't 
make Trainer worry...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems K.S.Miracle is exhausted from 
back-to-back races... I need to reconsider 
our upcoming race schedule.
